description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 1285011967843 GAUGING-CHARGING AS: Line 0001 Qty 31 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0138 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). Approved sources are 1HU06 5336165; 4K904 5336165. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
